summary: Standard chess vs Stockfish with neutral SCP-513 'Mal0' starting on c4. Mal0 secretly picks a random target piece (either colour), repositions to exactly 3 king-steps from it, then chases it one step per round and captures it when it reaches it, capturing anything it moves onto along the way. Mal0 ignores tempo and cannot be distracted. The narrator loses his queen, knight and pawns to Mal0, is nearly mated, but Mal0 captures the black king while hunting a rook and he wins.
rules: Standard chess otherwise; player White vs Stockfish (3600) Black.
Neutral Mal0 starts on c4 and moves one square (king step) per round, after Black's move.
Mal0 randomly chooses a target piece of either colour (kings included) - hidden from players.
On choosing a target, Mal0 moves to a square at distance 3 (king-step distance) from the target, then steps toward it each round ('stalks a random piece for three moves before capturing it').
Mal0 captures the target when it steps onto its square; it also captures any piece on a square it steps onto en route.
If the target escapes (moves away), Mal0 keeps pursuing ('pursuant but not inevitable'); it may reset to distance 3 when retargeting.
Mal0 capturing a king ends the game: that king's side loses (narrator won when Mal0 took the black king).
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish or have Mal0 capture the black king.
